raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts. For China exporters of firearms-related components, optics, and accessories, this shifts licensing thresholds and classification practice for US-bound shipments. Exporters must re-verify ECCN/ITAR jurisdiction, US HTS alignment, Section 301 tariff exposure, and BIS Entity List screening. Firearms and ammunition remain tightly controlled under the AECA/ITAR and EAR; only civilian items moved by the rescission may benefit. Confirm whether items fall under USML Category I or EAR ECCNs (e.g., 0A501, 0A502, 0A504) and whether a license exception applies. Retain end-user/end-use statements and chain-of-custody records for every US-bound consignment.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，恢复了对民用枪支、弹药及零部件的原有出口管制待遇。对于向美国出口枪械相关零部件、光学器件及配件的中国出口商而言，许可门槛与归类实践发生变化。出口商须重新核实ECCN/ITAR管辖、美国HTS归类、301关税风险及BIS实体清单筛查。枪支弹药仍受《武器出口管制法》/ITAR及EAR严格管制，仅被撤销规则覆盖的民用物项可能受益。应确认物项属于USML第I类还是EAR ECCN（如0A501、0A502、0A504），以及是否适用许可例外。每批输美货物须保留最终用户/最终用途声明及监管链记录。

checklist.desc: Re-classify firearms, ammunition, and parts against USML Category I and EAR ECCNs 0A501/0A502/0A504; confirm whether the rescinded rule changes licensing for your specific item.

checklist.task: BIS Entity List & restricted party screening
checklist.desc: Screen all US consignees, freight forwarders, and end users against the BIS Entity List, SDN, and denied persons lists; document results before shipment.
Map the 10-digit HTS line (e.g., 9302.00, 9303.30, 9305.20) against Section 301 lists and additional duties; document country of origin and value build-up.
Obtain and retain non-transferable end-user and end-use certificates for every US-bound firearms-related consignment, including resale restrictions.

checklist.task: FCC Part 15 / Part 18 for optics & electronics
checklist.desc: For firearm optics, rangefinders, and wireless accessories, confirm FCC Part 15/18 conformity and supplier FCC IDs before US entry.
Determine if a license exception (e.g., RPL, TMP) applies; file AES/EEI in ACE with correct ECCN, license code, and destination control statement.
